judgment.rationale: The issue includes historical improper-JSON log excerpts and a sample configuration, but those do not establish why parsing failed or whether it still occurs on a current build. No parser root cause is confirmed.
evidence: The reporter describes Keyboard Manager as intermittently not working and includes historical configuration/log material.
The sample uses string-form key identifiers and a semicolon-separated shortcut representation, forms handled by the current MappingConfiguration parser.
The thread has no confirmed current-version reproduction or linked fix.
judgment.recommended_action: Use a clean, current-build reproduction with the exact failing mapping and sanitized current configuration before changing parser behavior.

fix_assessment.rationale: The available old log snippet does not identify the invalid value or demonstrate a parser regression; proposing parser changes would be speculative.

issue_context.summary: An old intermittent Keyboard Manager report provides configuration/log evidence but does not establish a current parse failure or affected mapping.
known_information: The issue is labeled Issue-Bug, Needs-Triage, and Product-Keyboard Manager.
The body and comments include a sample mapping and an improper-JSON diagnostic from an earlier build.
The configuration's string-form originalKeys/newRemapKeys and semicolon-separated shortcut form are recognized by current parser code.
inferences: The symptom could depend on an invalid or stale configuration value rather than a defect in the current parser.
An intermittent runtime remap failure could also be unrelated to configuration parsing.
issue_context.analysis: The reported data should not be generalized into a parser bug. A current clean reproduction, plus the exact sanitized mapping and matching current log line, is needed before choosing parser versus event-handling investigation.
initial_investigation: Read the full issue and all four comments, including the old improper-JSON excerpt and sample mapping.
Read MappingConfiguration.cpp's parsing of string-form key values and shortcut separators; the sample's representation is accepted, but this does not prove why the historical log was emitted.

information_gaps.information: The exact sanitized mapping that fails, PowerToys version, and whether the same mapping produces a current parser diagnostic on a clean profile.
information_gaps.why_needed: The existing sample is not sufficient to distinguish invalid historical input, stale configuration, and an active runtime remap issue.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: On the latest stable build, export only the affected mapping with personal paths and unrelated mappings removed; record the exact trigger and the matching Keyboard Manager diagnostic line. Use the built-in bug-report bundle only if the focused sanitized configuration and log line cannot isolate it.

comment.body: The sample mapping uses string-form key values and shortcut separators accepted by the current parser, so the old “Improper JSON” excerpt does not yet show what failed. On the latest stable build, could you share the exact source-to-destination mapping that still fails, the version, and the matching Keyboard Manager diagnostic line? Please remove personal paths and unrelated mappings; no full bug-report bundle is needed unless those focused details cannot isolate the failure.
